cards.title: Anthropic's IPO Hits $111, Up 33% From $83
cards.body: Anthropic raised over $80 billion at its Nasdaq debut, with stock jumping to $111 on day one. The seven founders each pocketed $280 million, while the company's Public Benefit Foundation could receive up to $156 billion.

cards.title: Google Gives Gemini Mac Control Abilities
cards.body: Google's latest Gemini update brings an AI agent to Mac that can organize files, fill out forms, and handle multistep workflows. The agent automates repetitive desktop tasks directly on your computer.

cards.title: Meta's Muse AI Agent Leaks Private User Data
cards.body: Meta's Muse AI agent reportedly mixed up conversations and exposed private information, surfacing unrelated messages, bank balances, and purchase orders. Employees discovered instances where Muse generated false data about their personal activities.

cards.title: Jensen Huang Resigns From Nvidia Amid Scandal
cards.body: Nvidia's CEO Jensen Huang has resigned following an affair with potential national security implications as the U.S. and China race for AI infrastructure dominance. The scandal unfolds amid strong earnings reports and plans to halt H200 chip sales to China.

cards.title: Meta's Muse Charm Wearable Device Costs $300
cards.body: Meta's upcoming AI wearable, the Muse Charm, may retail for $300, competing with other AI agents like Claude and OpenAI Dots. Meta declined to confirm pricing but said it will share more details soon.

cards.title: Recent Tech Outages Mirror Y2K, Experts Warn
cards.body: Airlines, banking platforms, and productivity tools experienced outages that cybersecurity experts link to deeper systemic issues beyond coincidence. The pattern suggests AI agent-related complications in critical infrastructure.

cards.title: Apple Developing Its Own AI Agent for Mac
cards.body: Apple is reportedly building an AI agent to compete with Meta Muse, Instinct, Claude, and OpenAI Dots. The agent would run directly on Mac computers for user automation.

cards.title: Six AI Gadgets for Smarter Home Offices
cards.body: AI-powered notetakers, webcams, and other devices can upgrade your workspace setup. The list highlights consumer-ready AI tools designed for productivity.

cards.title: Nvidia's H200 Chips Banned From China Sales
cards.body: Amid Jensen Huang's resignation, Nvidia announced it will stop selling H200 chips to China as trade tensions escalate. The company reported healthy earnings growth despite leadership turmoil.

cards.title: Space Data Centers Face Financing Challenges
cards.body: Lenders hesitate to finance space operations because they fear collateral getting launched into orbit by SpaceX and others. The issue raises questions about financing long-term space infrastructure.

cards.title: AI Solves 167-Year-Old Riemann Hypothesis
cards.body: An AI-driven result claiming a solution to the Riemann hypothesis stunned mathematicians, with a competing human solution also emerging. The breakthrough highlights AI's growing role in advanced mathematics.

cards.title: Daniel Ek Backs AI Researcher's Fusion Startup
cards.body: Spotify founder Daniel Ek is investing in Europa Fusion, a fusion power startup founded by an AI researcher. The startup aims to advance clean energy technology.

cards.title: AI Agents for Text Messages: Top Picks Listed
cards.body: TechCrunch compiled the most notable AI agents that operate within text messaging apps, from general assistants to specialized travel and work agents. The list showcases the growing ecosystem of conversational AI.

cards.title: Hollywood Actors License Faces to AI Startups
cards.body: An actor licensed his face to a microdrama startup in a trend already popular in China, raising questions about long-term Hollywood consequences. Experts warn of potential exploitation if the practice becomes widespread.

cards.title: Two Nvidias: Earnings vs. Executive Calls
cards.body: Nvidia's earnings report shows strong performance, but tech executives are loudly calling for Jensen Huang's return despite his resignation. The contradiction highlights internal tensions over leadership.

cards.title: Signal Restricts Screenshots Over AI Surveillance
cards.body: Signal limited screenshot capabilities in its Android and iOS apps to combat AI-powered surveillance threats. The feature restriction represents a defensive move against emerging privacy risks.

cards.title: Big Tech Data Centers Face Public Backlash
cards.body: Journalist Paris Marx unpacks the growing backlash against hyperscale data centers in his new book 'Hyperscale.' The analysis reveals tensions between tech infrastructure expansion and public concerns.

cards.title: Everful Raises $48.5M for Factory-Direct Sourcing
cards.body: A former Alibaba executive's platform Everful secured $48.5 million to expand its factory-direct sourcing service. The platform connects retailers with Chinese manufacturers for overseas product sourcing.

cards.title: AI Capabilities Continue Exponential Improvement Trajectory
cards.body: METR's latest report shows AI capabilities are improving exponentially, though models struggle more with judgment-based tasks than coding. The findings update previous evaluations of AI performance across different problem types.

cards.title: AI Startup Creates Electronic Nose Matching Human Smell
cards.body: Researchers in New Jersey are training an AI model to identify odors using data from human sniffers cataloging Earth's scents. The startup claims its AI nose performs as accurately as human olfactory detection.

cards.title: AI Hype Index Shows AI Spreading Everywhere
cards.body: AI integration is accelerating across consumer products, from Google's AI Overviews costing ad revenue to AI-powered humanoid robots. The trend reflects both genuine innovation and speculative hype in the market.

cards.title: Google Launches AI Chat History in Search Homepage
cards.body: Google rolled out a redesigned search homepage featuring integrated AI chat history and removed the traditional search button. The update reflects Google's shift toward conversational AI as the primary search interface.

cards.title: Meta Reconsiders Net-Zero Goal Amid AI Emissions
cards.body: Meta is reconsidering its 2030 net-zero commitment due to record emissions from AI data centers. The company faces pressure between AI expansion and climate commitments.

cards.title: Researcher Discovers Privacy Breach in AI Supply Chain
cards.body: A researcher planted 2 million canaries throughout the AI supply chain, exposing significant privacy vulnerabilities. The discovery reveals critical gaps in data protection for AI development.
